featured_reviews.name: Minal Mankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
About 3 months ago, our 3-month-old puppy Mylo swallowed a large mutton bone from the trash. An initial X-ray at another hospital showed it was stuck in his throat near the neck. He was vomiting and not eating anything, and as time passed, he started breathing strangely, almost as if he was choking. We were extremely worried.

Through a common friend, we connected with Dr. Gaurav at Suyash Pet Clinic, Chembur. Even before we visited, he stayed in constant touch over the phone and guided us calmly. At the clinic, he immediately attended to Mylo, started him on saline, and did another X-ray. He clearly explained the situation, the size of the bone, the endoscopy procedure, and all associated risks, while also reassuring us throughout.

What truly stood out was his patience, kindness, and genuine care—not just for Mylo, but for us as anxious pet parents. He did everything he could to avoid surgery, and thankfully, the endoscopy was successful. Mylo recovered well, and we couldn’t be more grateful.

We had visited another hospital before this and felt very unsure due to their lack of clarity and significantly higher costs. In such emergencies, having a doctor who is both skilled and empathetic is truly a blessing.

Highly recommend Suyash Pet Clinic and Dr. Gaurav without hesitation. Writing this review after 2+ months, with a happy and healthy Mylo ❤️

featured_reviews.review_text: Took my cat to Dr. Deepa’s clinic for gastro issues. She wasn’t diagnosed properly and the staff at the hospital were not able to handle her as well. featured_reviews.review_text:
We brought Ginger, a stray cat, to Deepa’s Clinic in late May after he lost weight and was attacked by another cat. Other vets, including a multi-specialty hospital, said his condition was severe and he wouldn't survive more than a couple of days.

Under Dr. Trisha D’souza's care, Ginger was systematically diagnosed for weight loss due to high creatinine, treated for wounds, and corrected an abscess from a previous vet's IV. After weeks of testing by Dr. Trisha, Dr. Deepa, and Dr. Aditya, Ginger made a remarkable recovery. He went from 1.94 kgs to a healthy 5.3 kgs.

Dr. Deepa’s Clinic follows modern practices, has a great facility, and a compassionate staff. They not only care for pets but also show empathy towards pet parents. They take the time to explain diagnoses and courses of action during visits.

We highly recommend Dr. Deepa’s Clinic—your pets are in good hands

featured_reviews.name: Siddhi Vetal
featured_reviews.review_text: My beautiful, playful 3 year old kitty Koko suffered from a severe spinal injury unbeknownst to me with her symptoms showing up in the beginning of May. It had caused her to become paralyzed in her hind legs and she was as a result unable to use her litterbox or walk. She was unable to apply pressure of any kind using her lower half due to disk compression/herniation as diagnosed by the vets at Tata Trust small animal hospital. I was told that she may never walk again and that I should consider putting her down due to concerns regarding her quality of life with her being unable to poop or pee on her own. I was heart broken for my little girl and felt defeated. A day later I found out about Dr. Deepa Katyal's clinic and wasted no time in starting her treatment there. Dr. Deepa and her expert staff handled our case with so much love, care and dedication which helped Koko regain the strength in her legs within a week. After a month of daily treatments consisting of phototherapy and electroacupuncture Koko feels brand new and is back to being her usual energetic and mischievous self. I feel such relief as I watch her chase her little brother around the house and use the litterbox all on her own with ease just like she used to. I am eternally grateful to Dr. Deepa Katyal and her incredible staff for helping my Koko recover so miraculously and their selfless commitment to the cause of animal pain management. Needless to say Dr. Deepa Katyal's clinic is my go to for addressing any concerns regarding both of my cats. If any of you are in a similar situation, my heart goes out to you; Dr. Deepa Katyal's Animal Wellness and Rehabilitation Centre will take care of your pet and you♡

I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Shiwani Tandel and her team to any pet parent. Their dedication, skill, and compassion make them stand out in their field. I’m hoping my bunny recovers to 100% soon, and I truly appreciate everything they’ve done!

featured_reviews.name: 2069 Digamber Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m extremely grateful to The Cancer Vet for the care and treatment my dog, Brutus, received during his osteosarcoma surgery and chemotherapy.
From the very first visit, the entire team—from the front desk staff to the doctors—was incredibly helpful, caring, and approachable. They took the time to clearly explain all available treatment options, provided accurate cost estimates, and handled Brutus with exceptional skill and compassion.
A special mention goes to Dr. Shaurat, who performed the surgery. Her dedication was remarkable—she was available for us around the clock after the procedure, offering guidance and reassurance whenever we needed it. That level of commitment made a very difficult time much easier for us.
The hospital is well-equipped with advanced diagnostic tools and modern machines, which gave us confidence that Brutus was receiving the best possible care. The doctors were highly experienced and made sure he got the right treatment at every stage.
We were initially very worried about how Brutus would cope after the amputation of his front right leg, but the team reassured us—and they were absolutely right. He started walking as early as the very next day after surgery, which was truly amazing to see.
Overall, this is a fantastic veterinary hospital with a compassionate and skilled team. I would wholeheartedly recommend The Cancer Vet to anyone seeking specialized care for their pets.

featured_reviews.name: Indrani Bhattacherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
📢 Long Review Alert! Please bear with me, because this experience truly deserves a detailed review.

This was our very first visit to The Cancer Vet Clinic, and I would like to sincerely thank the entire team for the exceptional care, compassion, and professionalism they showed towards my baby , Pastry (Labrador).

From the moment we entered the clinic, the experience was different from any other veterinary visit we have had. Pastry is an anxious dog and usually becomes stressed during medical visits. However, before any examination even began, Receptionist Sanjana spent time playing with her, cuddling her, and making her feel comfortable. She treated Pastry with so much love that my baby immediately started feeling at ease. Receptionist Rakhi and the other staff members were equally warm and affectionate, making the clinic feel welcoming rather than intimidating.

A special thank you to Dr. Shubhangi Yelmule and Dr. Naveen Kumar. They were incredibly patient, thorough, and compassionate throughout the entire process. They carefully explained every step of the ultrasound, fluid removal, FNAC, and diagnostic procedures, ensuring that we understood what was happening and why. Their willingness to answer questions and keep us informed made a difficult day much easier to handle.

What impressed me the most was how they considered Pastry’s anxiety. Although they usually do not allow parents during certain procedures, they understood her situation and allowed me to stay with her because they saw that it helped her remain calm. That level of empathy and patient-centered care is RARE.

Despite undergoing multiple tests and procedures, including ultrasound-guided sampling, Pastry remained surprisingly comfortable. In fact, I can honestly say that I have never seen my baby feel this comfortable and cared for at any veterinary clinic before.

What touched me deeply was how every member of the team treated not just Pastry, but my Mom with kindness and respect. The lady who was helping around the clinic kindly offered tea to my mother and the lady managing the tea corner even helped and escorted my mother to the car, knowing that she walks with a stick.
These small gestures meant a lot to us during a stressful time.

The entire team combined medical expertise with genuine compassion, and for a worried pet parent, that makes all the difference.

Thank you once again !

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Thank you once again for your recommendation. Please give Pastry lots of love from all of us at The Cancer Vet. 🐾💙
